card.name: Intravenous infusion wording in administration steps
card.fires_on: Words in intravenous administration instructions that lead to or spell out infusion, such as 'infusion', 'intravenous', 'the' before infusion, and pieces of 'infusion' or 'admixtures'.

modes.label: Infusion word itself
modes.description: The word infusion, or the word just before it, in dosing and administration directions.

modes.description: Inside split-up words such as infusion, intravenous, admixtures or incompatibility.

card.plain: It fires on wording about giving a drug through an IV infusion, including how long and how fast.
